article.title: Conduct of suit.
article.content:
11Conduct of suit.

Order 1, Rule 11
The Court may give the conduct of 3[a suit] to such persons as it deems proper.

3 Subs. by s. 52, ibid., for “the suit” (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
